title: Dizzy plays warm and loves to jam
summary: Dizzy's clown image hides warm playing; he is a jam-session freak.

blocks.x: I heard Dizzy played very warm at times.
Everybody thinks he's the personality of a clown. But he can play warm, man.
I also heard him play very angry at times. I think he's a much more complicated fellow than he lets on.
He's a ______, he's a rumbler, he likes to rumble, man.
Oh, yeah. If it was jamming still, he'd be there every night.
You mean he likes the competition.
